text: __NOTOC__ The Warden's Court is on the third floor of the Vault of the Wardens. Demon hunters access this area by ascending the elevator within the Demon Ward all the way to the top, then crossing through two short flights of stairs. It is the location of the Pool of Judgment.
Wardruid Ko'chus is a Zandalari troll located in the Port of Zandalar in Dazar'alor. He and his Raptari team participate in Island Expeditions.

Waren Gearhart is a Mechagon mechagnome located on Mechagon Island. She joins the Dragonscale Expedition and can be found selling fishing supplies, next to Danielle Anglers, at the Wild Coast in the Waking Shores. She can be seen sitting with a kite.
Warden's Authority is an anima power obtained from Digested Anima after throwing a Ravenous Anima Cell at ... in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Warden Shackles is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Warlock's Bargain is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
__NOTOC__ Warden Dialash is a dracthyr flight master located at the Temporal Conflux in Thaldraszus. He is found dead in the Primalist Future.

Wards of the Dread Citadel is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by empowering the Argent Dawn Commission to unlock secrets within Naxxramas. Players must have already unlocked access to original Scholomance via the Memory of Scholomance achievement in order to progress on this achievement.

Wards of Naxxramas drop from Eyes of Naxxramas in Stratholme. They will only drop them while Scourgestones can be acquired. The ward can be broken at Crusaders' Square in order to gain Truesight revealing a hidden Scourge crystal. Destroying the crystal with Stratholme Holy Water will alert the Hand of Naxxramas.
Warmaul Hill is a large mountaintop in northwestern Nagrand. It is populated by a tribe of fierce ogres led by Cho'war the Pillager.
Warlords Deck is an item that begins the quest Darkmoon Warlords Deck, which rewards the player with a .
Warmaster Blackhorn is the sixth boss to appear in the Dragon Soul raid. World first heroic kill on 25-man achieved 8.12.2011 by Vodka - US-Alterac Mountains.
The Warlord's Garrison is a subzone of the Lost City of Tol'vir.
__NOTOC__ Warm Arcane Crystal has a chance to drop from in the uninstanced version of the Highmaul Underbelly in . It summons an Empowered Manafiend.
Warmongering Combatant is a Feat of Strength earned for winning 100 3v3 Arena matches or 40 Rated Battlegrounds in Warlords Season 3.
Warlord Dagu is a troll spectre siphoning power from :Azerite in a cave on the northwestern coast of Vol'dun.
Warlord Hjelskard is a vargul who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Warmace of Waking Nightmares drops from Shad'har the Insatiable in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Warm Leystone Deposit is a mining vein found in a cave near Obsidian Overlook in Highmountain.
Warlord Mo'gosh is an ogre located in Molten Cay during Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Warlord Ultriss is a twilight dragonspawn located in Island Expeditions.
Warm Blanket is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Warlord's Resolve is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
__NOTOC__ Warmongering Combatant's Emblem of Tenacity was sold by .
__NOTOC__ Warmongering Combatant's Medallion of Tenacity was sold by .
Warm Leystone Ore is mined from Warm Leystone Deposits in a cave near Obsidian Overlook in Highmountain.
__NOTOC__ Warp is an active pet ability used by Warp Stalkers.

The Warp Rift Generator is provided as an objective for From the Abyss. the item needs to be used at the crystals at the southern end of the Void Ridge region of Hellfire Peninsula. This will summon Void Baron Galaxis.
Warp Splinter Clipping is a quest item only lootable by players on the quest WANTED: A Warp Splinter Clipping. The quest is a random daily heroic quest from Wind Trader Zhareem in Lower City.
Warosh the Redeemed can be found within Hordemar City in Lower Blackrock Spire. This is Warosh's true form after finishing the quest.
Warp Time is a pet ability available exclusively to the warp stalker family of hunter pets, reducing enemy movement speed by 50% for 6 seconds.
Warp-Resistant Platings drop from Chronarch Defenders in the city of Suramar.
Warning Squawk is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Warning! is an ability used by Alarm-o-Bot (companion) during a Pet Battle.
Warmongering Gladiator's Emblem of Tenacity is no longer available to players.
Warmongering Gladiator's Medallion of Tenacity is no longer available to players.
Warpforged Key is purchased from Almaador in the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City. You must be with The Sha'tar to buy this item.
Warrior's Embrace is a Level 50 quality Plate Chest that improves Strength, Stamina and Dodge.
Warships are a type of ships including destroyers, battleships, carriers and frigates. Orcs of the Iron Horde on the alternate Draenor used those. Kul Tiras builds warships.

The Warsong Offensive is the main army of the Horde in Northrend, once led by Garrosh Hellscream and his second-in-command Varok Saurfang during the war against the Lich King. They have set up their base at Conquest Hold, in the Borean Tundra. These allied forces are also represented in the battlegrounds located on the Strand of the Ancients and Isle of Conquest, where they wage war against the Valiance Expedition. Together with the other expeditionary Horde forces in Northrend, they form the Horde Expedition. Following the fall of the Lich King, the majority of its troops left the frozen continent to return to Orgrimmar, guided by Garrosh himself, who handed the command of the Offensive for
Warpweaver Shafiee is an ethereal transmogrifier found in the Hall of Secrets in the Shrine of Two Moons.
Warpweaver Ramahesh is an ethereal transmogrifier found in the Ethereal Corridor in the Shrine of Seven Stars.

Warspear Outpost is the Horde base in Ashran. Found to the north of the main island, Warspear Outpost acts as the base of Horde operations within the PvP zone, featuring a graveyard, vendors and the zone's Horde Generals. It serves as a rally point for Horde players to turn in Artifact Fragments, seek repairs and purchase battlefield upgrades and new gear. Heavily-defended, it is nevertheless under constant threat from the Alliance, who seek to invade from the south. To the north of Warspear Outpost lies Warspear itself, the Horde's capital on . The Alliance equivalent is Stormshield Outpost, found at the south of Ashran.

Warspear is the main Horde base on , found on the north end of the island of Ashran. Set just outside the main PvP zone, Warspear is protected by Warspear Outpost, the Horde's main keep within Ashran proper. Warspear was presumably abandoned after the war in Draenor as its inhabitants returned to Azeroth. The Alliance equivalent is Stormshield, found at the south of Ashran.

Warsong Battleguards are orc and Forsaken guards found at Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra. They also appeared in Orgrimmar guarding the Forsaken Refugees after Varimathras and Putress took control of the Undercity. They also assisted in its subsequent attack and liberation.
The Warpwind Cliffs are found in Suramar. The cliffs contain scattered sections of Oculeth's Workshop, connected via teleporter.
Warsong War Riders are wyverns of the Warsong clan. They are ridden by Warsong Wing Commanders in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Warsong Wing Commanders are orcs located in Stonetalon Mountains. They ride on Warsong War Riders.
Warpweaver Swaggiss is an ethereal located outside the Magical Menagerie in Dalaran.

__NOTOC__ Warport Rastari is a Rastari military port in southern Zuldazar, urbanized but detached from the main city. Kaza'jin the Wavebinder grants the blessing of the loa on the ships here. The Kao-Tien mogu attacked it as a distraction during Zul's coup. Kaza'jin and Horde adventurers worked together to repel them. Later, it was fully retaken by the Zandalari and the Horde. The Alliance infiltrated it during their War Campaign.
The Warren of Decay is a chamber within the Maw of Gor'ma in Ny'alotha, the Waking City. It is here that Drest'agath is found.

Warsong Scramble is a PvP Brawl set in Warsong Gulch. In this Brawl, each team has 3 flags at their base, and players can capture enemy flags without their own flag at base. The first team to capture 10 flags wins. Additionally, buff cubes are scattered throughout the gulch and grant a one-time use of one of the following abilities when picked up: * * * *
The Warsong Flame Thrower drops from Krom'gar Incinerators in Windshear Crag in Stonetalon Mountains.
Warpweaver Zumzi is an ethereal transmogrifier located at Zen'shiri Trading Post in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.
Warpweaver Taxoss is an ethereal transmogrifier located at T&W Trading Post in the Canals in Stormwind City.

Warug is a centaur quest giver located in Magram Village in Desolace. He was a leader of the Magram, and acted as the spokesman for the clan in dealing with Horde or Alliance aid against their enemy clans. He was fairly simple-minded, concentrating primarily on his tribe's quest for superiority among centaurs, but he also had a soft spot for gadgets and gizmos, his favorite being the Target Dummies crafted by engineers. He was located near the base of the mountain range closest to the Magram settlement to the east, coordinates (74,68). He has been missing since the Cataclysm, most likely having been killed by the demons that invaded the area.
Watcher Elaira is a tauren druid found above Forge Camp Hate in Nagrand. She was once part of the druid Swift Flight Form quest line.
Watcher Callahan is a human located at the northeastern road, leading to Redridge Mountains, in Duskwood. He is guarding Kzixx and his wagon.
__NOTOC__ Watcher Moonleaf is a night elf located at the Steel Gate in the Howling Fjord.

Watch Captain Parker is a human Watch Captain, serving at Tower Watch in the Redridge Mountains, where he lives with his wife Darcy and their daughter Libby. Formerly known as Guard Parker, located at Three Corners, having been sent to patrol the roads there to assess the gnoll threat. Darcy once gave him a free lunch and he returned the favor by having flowers sent to her and she would later go on to become his wife and mother of his child. During the Fourth War, he visited Lakeshire Inn. Mathias Shaw intended to give him new orders.
An invisible and invulnerable ward that can see invisible units. Watcher Wards are permanent and cannot be dispelled.
Watchman's Rock is a small island in the Loch Varmad in Stormheim.
Watchful Inquisitors are inquisitors located in Court of Stars.
Watcher's Pendant of Courage is a quest reward from The Shattered Watcher.
Watchful Lookouts are Highmountain tauren located in Vol'dun, Nazmir, and Zuldazar during the Faction Assaults.
Watcher Heads are Uldum watcher heads found in the Chamber of the Stars in Uldum.

Wastewander Warriors are humans located in Ramkahen in Uldum. Two of them are escorting Arik Scorpidsting. They are also found in larger numbers over by the Obelisk of the Moon during the Assault in Uldum.
Wastewander Laborers are humans located at the courtyard of the Obelisk of the Moon in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum.
Wastewander Foremen are humans located at the courtyard of the Obelisk of the Moon in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum.
Wastewander Menders are humans located at the courtyard of the Obelisk of the Moon in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum.
Watcher's Scheming Girdle drops from the Carapace of N'Zoth in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
__NOTOC__ Watcher Morta is a high elf found in the Apothecarium of Undercity.

Ohn'ahran Plains= |-| Nokhud Offensive= Washengtu is a centaur flight master located at Broadhoof Outpost in the Ohn'ahran Plains and in the Nokhud Offensive (in which Broadhoof Outpost is considered part of the Nokhud Approach). They appear as female in the Ohn'ahran Plains, but male in the Nokhud Offensive.

The Watcher Log is found at on the bottom shelf near Lillian Brightmoon in the Azure Archives Annex of Valdrakken. The adventurer is tasked with getting information on the Sealed Titan Facility outside Tyrhold in Thaldraszus, and Watcher Koranos has the adventurer pick up the book in Speak to Koranos.

Wavestrider Beach was the shoreline in eastern Tanaris that stretched from Steamwheedle Port to the Lost Rigger Cove. This was where Desert Crawlers and Steeljaw Snappers roamed the beach. However, after the Cataclysm the beach was flooded and is now simply part of the ocean.

The Water Totem was required for a shaman to use water-aligned totems. If no Water Totem was in your inventory, you couldn't use water-aligned totems. All relic slot totems count as Water Totems, and if one is equipped or in the shaman's inventory, the Water Totem item is not needed. The Water Totem can never be destroyed, however, but if the character has a relic totem then the Water Totem can be placed in the character's bank instead of taking up inventory space.

The Watery Minion is a naga unit that results from the Naga Siren's Parasite ability after the target is killed. They resemble mur'guls, though Minions are far smaller. It helped both Illidan Stormrage and Lady Vashj in their efforts.

Wave Mistress is one of the frigates that belonged to the Third Fleet of Kul Tiras. It was destroyed by the Dragonmaw clan during the Second War and now lies as part of the Lost Fleet in Baradin Bay at the northwestern edge of the Wetlands, just south of another sunken boat, the Intrepid. Fitzsimmons was First Mate on the Wave Mistress.

Way stations are smaller Explorers' Guildhalls. They "are becoming established in far-flung corners of Azeroth, usually in the back rooms of inns or taverns along well-traveled routes to distant parts of the continent. Though they still vary in the level of service they can offer, some way stations can provide detailed maps of the local area while others stockpile supplies of dried foods and basic traveling necessities that can be drawn upon by Guild members (who are expected to pay for their withdrawals of Guild property whenever possible)."

The Waters of Farseeing is a bowl of water on a stone stand. They are used by Naraat the Earthspeaker (at the Eastern Earthshrine in Stormwind City during The Eye of the Storm (Alliance)) and Farseer Krogar (in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar during The Eye of the Storm (Horde)) to show the player the Maelstrom, being held in check by Thrall.

]] Watersmithing is a wood-panel scroll on a broken fish statue located at at Moonwater Retreat in southeast Jade Forest. Interacting with the scroll is one of the requirements of the Pandaria exploration achievement Fish Tales.

Waterspeaker's Sanctuary can be found in the center of Inkgill Mere in southeastern Kun-Lai Summit. The island is presently the source of the sha which have corrupted the jinyu in the village on the mere's eastern bank.
__NOTOC__ Watershaper Sharu is a jinyu found in the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Water Jet is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Water strider mounts are vanity mounts that were added in Mists of Pandaria. Water strider mounts could walk on water in non-battleground areas until patch 8.2 when as a result of the implementation of the mount equipment system, the water strider mounts lost their water-walking ability, but those who had a water strider mount received a free Anglers' Water Striders item in the mail on first login since the patch 8.2.0 dropped.
Watery Grave is an achievement earned for killing 3 of the Darkhatched Lizard-Lord's reinforcements using his Water Jets ability in the Dagger in the Dark scenario.

Water Management is an achievement earned from defeating Witherbark without him having absorbed any of his Aqueous Energy orbs in The Everbloom Heroic difficulty. The best way to make sure this doesn't happen is to position the boss as far away from the water as possible, preferably around the edges of the room. This ensures there's more time for the orbs to reach Witherbark, and more time to reach striking distance and destroy the orbs or let them be absorbed by the Unchecked Growth.
Wayfarer is awarded for completing the Real Race at the Darkmoon Faire with the Wanderluster within 25 tolls, the first in a series of four.
Waterfly is a pet that can be caught during a pet battle in , Talador, Spires of Arak and Tanaan Jungle.
, Sella, Rordan and Ethel.]] Waterwise is a family of Highmountain tauren of the Rivermane tribe.
Wax and Wane is a Balance druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Light of the Evening Star and Circadian Invocation traits.

Waycrest Manor is a dungeon in Battle for Azeroth. It is the home and seat of House Waycrest, located at the northwestern cliffs of Drustvar. Meredith Waycrest, now calling herself 'the Mother' as head of the Heartsbane Coven, tapped so freely into Gorak Tul's power that it emanates from the very walls of Waycrest Manor.

Wavespeaker's Star Chart is looted from the following chests in Stormsong Valley: *Forgotten Chest *Frosty Treasure *Hidden Scholar's Chest *Old Ironbound Chest *Small Treasure Chest *Smuggler's Stash *Sunken Strongbox *Venture Co. Supply Chest *Weathered Treasure Chest
The Waves of Power is found at the Scavenger's Strand in Zuldazar.
Wayfinder's Satchel is a possible reward from island expeditions.
Water Terrors are water revenant minions of Mjordin Water Magi located in Jotunheim in Icecrown. Empowered versions appeared during Death Rising.
Watery Servants were water elementals accompanying Twilight Seeker in Stormwind City and Durotar during the Elemental Unrest.

__NOTOC__ Wavespeaker Reid is a human tidesage that is confronted for the first time at Layson & Sons Rigging in Stormsong Valley by the Alliance emissary. He can next be found transformed into a k'thir in the Sagehold. Commander Augustine later found his body at the Wavespeaker's Sanctum. As a member of the Abyssal Council, he trains initiates in the oldest form of tidesage magic: communing with the sea.
Water Prisons are magical prisons made of water. They are located in the Imperial Gardens in Nazjatar. They contain Nazjatari Taken.
Wavebreaker is a naga brute who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.

The Wavemurder Barge was a planned Iron Horde means of transportation that would appear in the Central Dock in Gorgrond. The Azerothian Commander would board it with the help of Rokk to destroy the ship.
Wavespeakers (or wave-speakers) are shaman commonly found in the ranks of the Earthen Ring. They appear to specialize in water magic.

Way of the Fae is a conduit for monks in the Night Fae covenant. It drops from the following bosses: *Tred'ova in the Mists of Tirna Scithe *Sire Denathrius in Castle Nathria *The Prototype Pantheon in the Sepulcher of the First Ones *Valinor in Bastion *Mortanis in Maldraxxus *Oranomonos the Everbranching in Ardenweald *Nurgash Muckformed in Revendreth. An ilvl 145 version is also rewarded from Strengthening the Bond (Night Fae).
Watertight Kafa-Flasks are sold for by Bump-On-A-Log and Stick-In-The-Mud during Island Expeditions.
Wavebringer Sezzes'an is a saurok located in Island Expedition.
Wax-Sealed Leather Bracers drop from Drugon the Frostblood in Highmountain.
Wayfinder Ros is a broker flight master. While his whereabouts are unknown, a Bundle of Writings left by him, are found near the Ancient Translocator in Haven.
__NOTOC__ Duck Meat is a cooking ingredient in Dragonflight Cooking. It drops from ducks in the Dragon Isles.

Way of the Wonderous Wavewhisker, summons Wonderous Wavewhisker, which is a fish mount that not only acts as a flying mount that can swim through the air, but also as an aquatic mount that increases swim speed by 100% while in water.

Weasels are little mammals that are aggressive predators, but usually confine themselves to smaller prey. If a weasel hits with a bite attack, it uses its powerful jaws to latch onto the opponent's body and automatically deals bite damage as long as it remains attached. An attached weasel loses its agility. An attached weasel can be struck with a weapon or grappled. To remove an attached weasel through grappling, the opponent must achieve a pin against the creature.
The Weathered Bookcase is located inside a building in the Ruins of Alterac of Alterac Mountains.
"Weathered Diary - Dates from the Third War" is a book in Dalaran which can spawn in place of The Schools of Arcane Magic.
Webbed Crusaders need to be rescued in Scourge Tactics. Destroying the cocoons will either spawn a Freed Crusader or a Forgotten Depths Ambusher.
Webwinder Hollow, formerly Sishir Canyon, is a large valley just off of Webwinder Path in the Stonetalon Mountains. The valley is filled with Deepmoss spiders and their queen, Queen Silith.
Weakening Blow is an ability used by the Terrible Turnip during a Pet Battle.
Weakness is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Weaver Aoa is a draenei tailoring trainer and vendor located on Aldor Rise in Shattrath City.
The Weapons Cabinet is located at the Mountainfoot Strip Mine in Azshara. It belongs to Horzak Zignibble.
Web Spray is a pet ability available exclusively to the spider family of hunter pets.

__NOTOC__ Weary-Eyed Mourners consist of various Alliance races and different character classes that can be found in Stormwind City, particularly at the Stormwind Keep. They appear after the adventurer has returned from the Broken Shore, and are mourning the death of Varian Wrynn. Many of them look like the various Lunarfall followers. Fargo Flintlocke being a possible follower, he may also appear among the mourners. One version looks like Nikova Raskol.
Webmistress Shinaris is a fal'dorei located at the Shattered Locus in Suramar. She caught Verstok Darkbough into her web but was killed by the druid adventurer.
The Weathered Supply Crate can be found in the Canals between the Trade District and Old Town in Stormwind City. Opening the box will cause an aggressive Giant Rat to leap out.
Wealthy Elites are nightborne located in the Court of Stars.
Weathered Runestone is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Weathered Talisman of the Shadowmoon is dropped by the Remnant of Ner'zhul in the Sanctum of Domination.

We Are All Made of Stars is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Rygelon with all players under the effects of Herald of the Cosmos in the Sepulcher of the First Ones on Normal Difficulty or higher.

We'll Never See That Again, Surely is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Scalecommander Sarkareth after cultivating a Lump of Flesh and hurling it into the Emptiness Between Stars in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible on Normal difficulty or higher.

Westfall borders the Kingdom of Stormwind and is mostly populated by humans not under the Alliance’s complete control. The region was stolen right under the Alliance’s nose by its own bitter people. This rich land has lain fallow since the Second War, but it is now held by the Defias Brotherhood. Stormwind claims the land as its own, but it has found little time to be concerned with it, with insufficient funds and might to retake the region. A handful of farmers still try to keep their land, and some even attempt a tithe to Stormwind every year, but most only grow enough to feed themselves. The Defias Brotherhood controls much of the region, focused in the southern area of Moonbrook. Once a

Wendigo (sometimes pluralized as wendigos) are large, furry, horned humanoids similar to yeti and sasquatch. They are indigenous to Northrend but can also be found in the mountains of Dun Morogh. Cannibalistic, savage and exceedingly voracious, wendigo are solitary by nature and rarely live amongst others of their kind. They are highly territorial and do not take kindly to intruders strumbling into their hunting grounds. The wendigo of Northrend are believed by many to be the primordial cousins of the southern variety that dwell in Dun Morogh. They differ in appearance from their southern cousins, being significantly larger with more ape-like builds and curved horns. Though rarely seen, the

Westbrook Garrison is a barracks of the Stormwind Guard located in Forest's Edge on the western end of Elwynn Forest, near the border with Westfall, which was once controlled by agents of the Defias Brotherhood and their dreaded mechanical harvest golems. Because of the corruption and political instability caused in the kingdom by Lady Katrana Prestor, the Westbrook Garrison lived through difficult times when they had to deal with an increasing gnoll and thief activity coming from Westfall. With the bulk of the Stormwind Army abroad, they barely had enough men to keep the roads of the region safe. At some point, Deputy Rainer requested more Stormwind soldiers from Marshal Dughan in Goldshire

West of the entrance to Gnomeregan is a broad valley running north from Coldridge to the mountains bordering the northwestern end of Dun Morogh. The valley is clearly visible on the zone map but has no name. As of patch 4.0.3a, the zone has been fleshed out and filled with trees. There are Alpine Hare companions available for pet battles, as well as a couple of Black Bears that are menacing Anton and Jermaine Buckey.

Webwinder Path is a main stretch of road that goes from Malaka'jin, all the way to Mirkfallon Lake. The southern part of the path seems to have been hit hard by the Shattering much of the land the runs alongside the path has sunk a great amount. The Horde setup up a barricade just west of Malaka'Jin in order to prevent the Alliance from heading further east. Aramar Thorne and Makasa Flintwill led their groups through the path. When they looked skyward, Makasa and Murky noticed how the forest above was made into a labyrinth of spider webs formed into tunnels and loops, a veritable fortress of glittering ivory strands, with hundreds of spiders.

The West Frostwolf Tower is a watch tower located just north of Frostwolf Keep. Like all Horde towers in Alterac Valley, it is guarded by archers with relatively weak melee attack ability. Wing Commander Ichman is held prisoner at the base of the tower and can be rescued to provide aerial support for the Alliance.

__NOTOC__ Webwood Spiders are fel-corrupted tarantulas that live in and around the Shadowthread Cave in northwestern Shadowglen. The corruption these spiders suffer from is not simply surface deep. It cannot be magic or subtle mal intent. It is bred into them. Their broodmother, Githyiss the Vile, was corrupted by a totem belonging to the Gnarlpine tribe.

The West Sanctum is an arcane sanctum located on the western isle of Eversong Woods. It suffered from a malfunction that caused the destruction of a power converter and has since been overrun by Manawraiths and Mana Stalkers. It is also being observed by Darnassian Scouts. Atop the sanctum is a platform with a Tattered Chest; how to get there is unknown. Ley-Keeper Velania was tasked with its maintenance.

]] Westguard Keep is situated atop the Howling Fjord cliffs on its western side. It has a joint human and dwarven population similar to Valgarde. In the center of the keep is a dwarven statue. During the war against the Lich King, the keep was the doorway to Northrend by air. At some point, they sent a shipment of ammo to Wintergarde Keep by the way of flying machines, but they were intercepted by frost wyrms of the Scourge. The keep also lent some of them to the Explorers' League at Steel Gate. The Lady Lug, a commandeered goblin zeppelin, was also anchored there. During the trial of Garrosh Hellscream on Pandaria, the keep was attacked by the True Horde in order to free and recruit the gob
Welldrip Gloves are a quest reward from Deep Ocean, Vast Sea.

This Westfall questing guide details an efficient method to obtain and complete quests in Westfall. For a list of all Westfall quests in table format, see Westfall quests. Note: This guide is not meant for power-leveling purposes. Rather, it is meant to show a player an efficient way to complete many quests available for a particular zone. If you know of a better order or method to accomplish this, your input is welcome (in fact, greatly desired).

Well Read is an exploration achievement earned for reading an assortment of books across the world and instances of Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. The location with the greatest concentration of books is Stormwind City. Scarlet Monastery's Library wing and Scholomance also have great variety of books.
The West Frostwolf Warmaster guards Drek'Thar in Frostwolf Keep in Alterac Valley until the West Frostwolf Tower is destroyed.
The West Frostwolf Marshal guarded Vanndar Stormpike in the fortress of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley after the West Frostwolf Tower was destroyed.

__NOTOC__ Westreach Summit is tauren village located in the northwestern corner of Thousand Needles. The Horde there are under attack by marauding members of the Grimtotem tribe. On top of the summit is Kanati Greycloud leading the defense with several Summit Defenders and Nah'te the flight master. Motega Firemane can be found near the water. After the Fourth War, Zekhan reported that the summit is controlled by the Horde.
The West Pavilion was the northwestern pavilion found in the Darkmoon Faire. It was torn down to make room for the Merry-Go-Round.

Weezil Slipshadow is a goblin quest giver who has infiltrated Bael'dun Keep in the Southern Barrens. After succeeding in his mission to destroy Bael'dun Keep, he was not able to escape alongside the Horde adventurer and was killed by the blast.
The West Spire is a destructible building in northwestern Tol Barad. It can be destroyed with the two Abandoned Siege Engines that spawn nearby at the entrance to D-Block for more time.

Welcome to the Deadmines is the winning entry for "World of Warcraft Movie Contest: Rise to Power" 2010. It's a song dedicated to the Deadmines and the upgrade it received in Cataclysm. It's features all the old bosses of deadmines as they sing a musical number. When this was done, the makers may have not known that the Deadmines bosses where being removed or they did and decided to go with it anyway. Either-way it still placed first. ;Music Composer: Irdeen ;Lyrics by: Irdeen & Jesse Cox ;Editor: Adrian Drott
The Well-Loved Toys are items sometimes found in Sack of Pet Supplies. They can also be fished from a Hyper-Compressed Ocean.
Weng the Merciful is a representative of the Golden Lotus sent to the Shrine of Two Moons to enlist Horde aid. He is a plump, soft-spoken pandaren who has become a fixture at the shrine.
Wei Lakebreeze is a representative of the Order of the Cloud Serpent sent to the Shrine of Two Moons to recruit Horde. She can be found on the lower level of the Golden Terrace.

Wen'lor is a talbuk who was used by Aggra during Thrall's trip in Nagrand. In the The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm, though not named, Aggra's riding talbuk was described as a beautiful blue hue, and seemed feistier than Shuk'sar, Thrall's mount.

Wendy Vetter is lead dungeon artist for World of Warcraft. She provided direction for the creation of the Alliance Mage Tower and Lumber Mill Garrison features. Vetter also contributed to the [http://eu.battle.net/wow/en/blog/12811675/artcraft-building-a-garrison-11-02-2014 Artcraft — Building a Garrison] Warlords of Draenor preview blog, and the [http://us.battle.net/wow/en/blog/16198765/ Warlords of Draenor Dungeon Preview: Training Day] blog, where she shared some insight into the artistic development process for Warlords of Draenors Iron Docks and Shadowmoon Burial Grounds instances.
Archmage Wendol was an archmage of Dalaran of whom Jaina Proudmoore briefly read.
__NOTOC__ Weeping Wisps are wisps located at the Blind Marshlands in Highmountain. They are quite shy and will attempt to flee when approached.
Western Watch is an island in western Drustvar. The Alliance has a foothold here.
Weeping Spirits are orc ghosts located in the Crypt of the Ancients in Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
__NOTOC__ Weeping Necroliths are undead night elves located in Highmountain. They are stationary so long as you face them, but they move towards you at an incredibly high speed if you look away.
Weight of Darkness is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Weightless Spirit is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Weight of Judgment drops from Empowered Ravagers, Mawsworn Wardens and Mawsworn Interrogators at the Seeker's Quorum in Korthia.
This quest is given by Guard Berton who is in Lakeshire, Redridge Mountains.

The Wetlands farm is in southwestern Wetlands roughly south of Menethil Harbor usually reachable by falling down the mountainside from near the Dun Morogh airfield in Dun Morogh. This area has a series of small farmland plots around a pond at the base of a tall waterfall. Each farmland plot has haystacks and cows with a nearby dwarf-style house set into the hillside. The area itself is on a plateau above normal Wetlands areas. There are a few NPCs, some animals, dwarven farmers and some guards in the area. Two night elf NPCs, Ranadae and Kartanus, sit by a small pool. In the middle of the area is a signpost with three directions. To the north it reads, "This way," to the west, "The other way

This is a questing guide detailing an efficient method to obtain and complete quests in Wetlands. For a list of all Wetlands quests in table format, see Wetlands quests. Note: This guide is not meant for power-leveling purposes. Rather, it is meant to show a player an efficient way to complete many quests available for a particular zone. If you know of a better order or method to accomplish this, your input is welcome (in fact, greatly desired).
Whiplash is an ability of the Sayaad, a warlock minion. It instantly deals shadow damage and knocks back all enemies within 5 yards.
What was Briefly Yours is Now Mine is an achievement earned by using the archaeology skill to find ten rare artifacts. It awards players with the title of Associate Professor.
Where's the Beef? is an ability used by the Pygmy Cow during a pet battle.
What's Your Sign? is an achievement earned from defeating Sadana Bloodfury while only having the runes that correspond to her active lunar cycle lit in Shadowmoon Burial Grounds on Heroic difficulty.

Wheatizzle is a blood elf or human (depending on the race of the player) paladin that is a part of the Uber Town group. She can be briefly seen during the flashback of the confrontation with Illidan Stormrage atop the Black Temple.
The Wheel of Fortitude is located in Stonedark Grotto in Highmountain.
What a Feeling is a world event achievement earned by getting a perfect score in the Darkmoon Faire Dance game on the medium difficulty.
Weyrnrest is a located in northwestern Valdrakken. It serves as a gathering point for many of the dracthyr now found in the city.
Which Knot Was It Again? is a reputation achievement earned by unlocking climbing World Quests with the Dragonscale Expedition by completing the Climb Every Mountain quest unlocked at Renown 6.

Whelpling's Shadowflame Crest Fragment drops from raid finder Aberrus raid bosses and the end-of-run chest in a Mythic+ key in the 2–5 range. Additionally, open-world rare creatures (but not rare-elites) and small treasures will also drop fragments. Combine fifteen to make a Whelpling's Shadowflame Crest, used to upgrade Dragonflight Season 2 items to item levels 402–411.
Whirlwind is a warrior ability that deals damage to all nearby enemies.
Whittling Knife is a quest reward from Rite of Strength (Classic).

Whitereach Post was a small Horde camp along the road near Camp E'thok in Thousand Needles. It was destroyed during the Cataclysm and flood soon to follow. Its possible survivors made their way to Westreach Summit, though it's unknown since only Kanati Greycloud has been seen since.

Whulwert Copperpinch is a vendor located on the lower rise in the tauren city of Thunder Bluff during the Feast of Winter Veil event. He is affiliated with Smokywood Pastures, and sells higher value holiday related items. His low value counterpart is
White Drakeskin Cap is reward from the quest Foul Magics (2) which starts with Tor'gan in Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.

White damage is damage dealt from your common abilities that consume no mana, energy, or rage. This includes auto-attack, shoot, throw, auto-shot, and the like. It is so called because the value of the damage is displayed on screen in white as opposed to yellow. A white crit would be any crit of a white-damage attack.

Whirligig Wafflefry is a level 71 gnome NPC located on the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City near the Scryers bank. He has the title of "Gnomish Inventor". He reported a disturbance at the Spirit Fields around Oshu'gun in Nagrand.
Why? Because It's Red is a feat of strength achievement earned by obtaining a Red Qiraji Resonating Crystal, a somewhat rare drop in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj.

Whisperwind Grove is a neutral town of the Emerald Circle, a largely autonomous branch of the Cenarion Circle. Whisperwind Grove is located just south of Irontree Woods in Felwood. Notably, the land around Whisperwind Grove has been cleansed of corruption, and it is the location of the only uncorrupted moonwell in all of Felwood.

The Whispering Stones can be found on the southwestern side of the Zan'vess island. The Amber Quarry is just to the east. They are critical for long range communications, and Adjunct Sek'ot uses them to maintain communication between the Zan'thik and Grand Empress Shek'zeer.

Whitepetal Lake is one of the larger lakes found in central Vale of Eternal Blossoms. The lake is fed by the water source in the mountains to the south near Mistfall Village and is overlooked by a temple on its eastern side. The lake itself is filled with different fish, including frenzies, and crocolisks.
Whirlpool is an ability used by crabs and other pets during a Pet Battle.
artwork.]] The White Riding Camel is a loot card from WoW TCG expansion, Tomb of the Forgotten. The code unlocks the ability to purchase the item from Landro Longshot in Booty Bay.
Whispers of the Djinn is an archaeology quest that grants your group the Whisper of the Djinn buff, slowly regenerating health and mana for all party members while in the Vortex Pinnacle.

Whitewater Wash is a river leading into the Sylvan Falls in Highmountain, found west of Thunder Totem. The area features important tauren fisheries as well as several caves, including Lifespring Cavern. The area was attacked by rampaging drogbar, smashing everything they could find, throwing fish to the shore, and capturing Rivermane tauren. Jale Rivermane and the adventurer arrived and helped free the captured tauren, returned the distraught fish to the river, and got revenge on the drogbar by using their own alchemy against them.
White King is a chess piece found in Karazhan. He is the main opponent of the Black King and both sides try to destroy each other.

Who's Afraid of the Dark? is an achievement earned by defeating Cordana Felsong in Vault of the Wardens on Mythic difficulty after navigating through her Creeping Doom ability without using Elune's Light.

White Eyes is said to be as immovable as a mountain, as pitiless as a storm, and as swift as lightning. However, there is one thing that most people, even most members of the Jade Lotus, don't know, which is that White Eyes is not the true leader of the organization.
Why Can't I Hold All this Mana? is a quest achievement earned from obtaining all Ancient Mana capacity increases.
Whisperwind is a destroyer located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in .

Whiskey is a wolf that lives under the stairs at Big Mountain Mining Supply Co. in the Tradewinds Market in Boralus. It will occasionally make its rounds and stop by Byron & Bros. Boralan B.B.Q. to stare at the meat and at the stables of Leila Stafford to eye the eggs.
__NOTOC__ Whirlwing is a large gray gryphon found flying in the sky at the southern end of the Clearcut in Stormsong Valley.
Whistlebloom Harvesters are wasps that fly around Whistlebloom Oasis in Vol'dun. Some are seen tending to Loose Whistlebloom Hives or clutches of Whistlebloom Eggs.
Whistlebloom Eggs are wasp eggs clinging to Infested Saurolisk corpses around Whistlebloom Oasis in Vol'dun. Destroying them releases Whistlebloom Drones.

The Whiskerwax Candle is a toy that puts a Kobold Candle Helm on your head. This item is a reward from Treasure Map missions, completing Island Expeditions, and occasionally contained in Skittering Hollow Salvage.

Whirling Zap-O-Matic is a gnomebot located in the Engineer's Respite on Mechagon Island. Tyler Swaptech told mechagnomes not to build it, but they didn't listen. It eventually went out of control and killed everyone.
Whirring Chainblade has a chance to drop from rare mobs on Mechagon Island.
White Pollen Mote is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Whitewater Groupers are grouper located in Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
White Death is a ravager wasp located in Island Expeditions.
The Whirling Dervish Vest is an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Elemental Salvage.
The Whirling Dervish Belt is an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Elemental Salvage.
The Whirling Dervish Striders are an Island Expedition reward.
The Whirling Dervish Shoulders are an Island Expedition reward.
The Whirling Dervish Gloves are an Island Expedition reward.
The Whirling Dervish Breeches are an Island Expedition reward.
The Whirling Dervish Bindings are an Island Expedition reward.
Whirling Stormgem is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Whispers of the Jailer is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Whizzard Hat is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

"Why the Mermaids Left Boralus" is a short story by Tamsyn Muir published in the anthology Folk & Fairy Tales of Azeroth. It is illustrated by Cory Godbey. The story tells of the relationship between the mermaid Halia and the tidesage Ery, and of how their love ended up saving the city of Boralus from a fierce storm early in its history.
Whispering Shard of Power is dropped by the Remnant of Ner'zhul in the Sanctum of Domination.

, a wight in the Trading Card Game.]] Wights are an unusual species of undead used occasionally by the Scourge. They most closely resemble a zombie, but their bodies have grown to monstrous sizes and are horridly deformed. It is unknown how this transformation occurred. They are mostly employed in places of importance: Magistrate Barthilas protects the key to the city of Stratholme, while two other wights (Feugen and Stalagg) act as the bodyguards of the flesh titan Thaddius. In addition, The Ravenian is one of the six bosses that must be defeated to summon Darkmaster Gandling in the Scholomance.

A Wickerman is a straw construct resembling a humanoid. A Wickerman is burned by the Forsaken near the walls of Lordaeron during the Wickerman Festival to honor Queen Sylvanas and their escape from the Scourge. After the Cataclysm, Gilneas reintroduces the practice of burning the Wickerman to the Alliance. For the Alliance, the wickerman embodies any unrest, fear, or uncertainty within them. They set it ablaze with the hope of tempering themselves against whatever tomorrow may bring. Gilneans burn one outside of Stormwind City. Smaller wickermen are also burned in other parts of the world during Hallow's End in order to practice putting out fires from the attacks by the Headless Horseman. Th
Wild Berries were a reagent for Rank 1 of the Druid Gift of the Wild ability, and could be purchased from reagent vendors.

Part of the Hallow's End event, the Wickerman Festival takes place in Tirisfal Glades as part of an annual Forsaken celebration. The Forsaken burn a Wickerman to celebrate their liberation from the Scourge. The Forsaken had a few s to protect the festivities, until the event was moved into the Ruins of Lordaeron courtyard. The Wickerman Ember can be found only during Hallow's End in Tirisfal Glades, west of Undercity. At night, the Wickerman is set ablaze allowing players to click on embers to receive a 2 hour buff.
Widow Venom was a hunter ability that allowed the hunter to reduce the healing on the target shot.
Widow's Peak is a mountaintop overseeing Briarback Kraul and the Sprucewood in southern Stormsong Valley.

__NOTOC__ Wicked Wort is the leader of the Brittlebark spriggans attacking the Growthworks in Ardenweald. He has used fae magic to make himself invisible. However, he's terribly allergic to puffpetal powder and can't help but sneeze when exposed to it.
Wild Flail of Tollar is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
__NOTOC__ Wild Corpseflies are corpsefly critters located in Korthia.

Widow's Web are web cocoons located in the Widow's Wail in the Jade Forest. When destroyed, one of the following will be released: *Slitherscale Eggdrinker *Oona Brewchugger *Frenzied Caterpillar *Freed Sri-La Villager

The Wild Growth Spaulders are excellent gear for a balance or restoration druid, restoration or elemental shaman, or holy paladin. These are the best healing shoulder items for druids until Dreamwalker. The extra spell power on these make them more effective than both Stormrage Pauldrons and Cenarion Spaulders.
Wild Imps was a Demonology warlock ability, available at level 32. It summoned Wild Imps.
Wild Strike is a Fury warrior ability, available at level 18. Bloodthirst has a 20% chance of granting 2 charges of Wild Strike that cost no Rage.
Wild Mountain Goats are located at Burlap Trail in Kun-Lai Summit and the Veiled Stair.
Wild Mountain Kids are goats found throughout Kun-Lai Summit.
Wild Mushroom: Bloom is a Restoration druid ability, available at level 84.
Wild Winds is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Many of them appear in the form of gargantuan animals, such as wolves, bears, tigers, or birds. The Wild Gods of Azeroth are creatures of two realms, for while they inhabit the physical world, their spirits are bound to the ethereal Emerald Dream. When Wild Gods die, they go to Ardenweald and enter a wildseed to be taken care of by keepers of the groves of one of the celestial trees until they are ready to be reborn through the Grove of Awakening. Wild Northern Barracuda Schools can be found west of the Shipwreck Cove in Highmountain.

Wild Moonfall Hippogryphs are hippogryphs located in Suramar. During Take Them in Claw, they are summoned by Vial of Hippogryph Pheromones to attack Nightborne Siegecasters and Nightborne Infiltrators.
Wild Hunt's Charge is a soulbind trait granted by Korayn. It is exclusive with Horn of the Wild Hunt. It grants the Wild Hunt's Charge active ability.
Wild Throw is an ability that would be used during a Pet Battle.

__NOTOC__ Wild Three-assed Mantaurs were creatures that roamed Uldum during the alpha and early builds of the beta. They consisted of three naked male human models stitched together to form a bizarre chimera: one serving as the Mantaur's head, torso, and front legs, a second lying on his stomach serving as the back, and a third smaller one (about half the size of the first) serving as the creature's posterior and hind legs. Players could ride them as vehicles. They were used as placeholders for the then-unfinished tol'vir, so that environment artists could reference them for scale when building areas where the tol'vir lived. In the quest Escape From the Lost City, Budd Nedreck has the advent
Wild Magic Insulating Bands drop from Grand Artificer Zeerak at the Cobalt Assembly in the Azure Span.

The Wildbend River is a tainted river in the southern part of Darkshore, near the Grove of the Ancients. The river is tainted at its source, which lies in the nearby corrupted Felwood. The taint is carried downstream and is partly responsible for the similar corruption of the landscape, wildlife, and furbolg tribes in Darkshore. Swimming in the river is not recommended. Wildbend River is a continuation of Bloodvenom River from Felwood as it cascades down the mountains to Darkshore.

William Pestle is a human quest giver located in the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. He and his brother Morgan Pestle run the apothecary in the Trade District of Stormwind City. He uses his skills as an alchemist to create an Invisibility Liquor so that Maybell Maclure can secretly visit her love, Tommy Joe Stonefield without their feuding families finding out. He is an old friend of Mildred Stonefield. Jimb "Candles" McHannigan claims that he was William's number-one supplier of candles.

Wiley the Black is a human quest giver located in the Lakeshire Inn in the Redridge Mountains. Gryan Stoutmantle once did a significant favor for him; in Wiley's own words, Gryan saved his life. As repayment, Wiley revealed information about the Defias Brotherhood. He joined the Uncrowned and is found in the Hall of Shadows. He sits on a barrel, fishing. He later traveled to Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore. He is standing next to Master Longfang in stealth.

Wildhammer dwarves are a type of dwarf currently centered mainly in the Hinterlands and the Twilight Highlands; although many others can be found in Kalimdor and Outland as well. The Wildhammer dwarves are renowned for their close bond with gryphons, they treat these animals as equals in battle instead of pets, leading to numerous successes in the Second and Third Wars. They also value nature and have close ties to shamanism. The bulk of their people are led by the eponymous Wildhammer clan. The ancient fortress of Grim Batol was once a massive Wildhammer dwarf city, though it was lost following the War of the Three Hammers. They are also referred to as wild dwarves, feral dwarves, Aerie dwa
Will of the Mountain Giant is a quest reward from Weapons of Spirit.

Wildpaw Ridge is a camp of the Wildpaw gnolls located in the mountains to the east of Field of Strife. The Veiled Cleft can be found on the right, above the ridge. Due to an avalanche, their camp was blocked off from the rest of Alterac Valley.
Wildspawn Satyr are satyrs located in Dire Maul. Their attacks are standard warrior abilities. They drop nothing of note, except Satyr Blood which is a quest objective for The Prison's Bindings.

__NOTOC__ William is a human boy seen running in Trade District and the borders of Cathedral Square, Old Town, and Dwarven District in Stormwind City. Before the Cataclysm he was chased by Donna because he stole her doll, Betsy. Since Cataclysm, William is now chasing Donna for stealing his mechanical gorilla.
Will to Survive is an instant cast Human racial ability. It removes all active stun effects.

The Wildgrowth Mangal is jungle-like area in central Sholazar Basin northwest of River's Heart between the Suntouched Pillar and Rainspeaker Canopy. It's a dense jungle shot through with small streams that spreads across the basin's central area. It is home to quite a few dangerous reptiles, such as the Emperor Cobras and Mangal Crocolisks. At the time of the war against the Lich King, Monte Muzzleshot, a dwarf of the Nesingwary Safari, got shot down here with his flying machine by a pilot of the Venture Company. He hung for days from the branches of a tree, caught by his parachute. Fortunately, many of the trees are laden with fruit, so Monte shouldn't starve.
__NOTOC__ William Mullins is a Forsaken located in the Ruins of Lordaeron in Undercity.
